final: WITH spatial_with_projects AS (SELECT sp.arcref, sp.boxx, sp.boxz, p.fundflux FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), spatial_with_ratios AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, CASE WHEN boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxz IS NOT NULL AND boxz != 0 THEN boxx / boxz ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM spatial_with_projects), project_ratios AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(ratio) as project_ratio FROM spatial_with_ratios GROUP BY arcref, fundflux HAVING AVG(ratio) IS NOT NULL), funding_source_avgs AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(project_ratio) as funding_avg FROM project_ratios GROUP BY fundflux), final_results AS (SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.project_ratio, pr.project_ratio - fsa.funding_avg as excess FROM project_ratios pr INNER JOIN funding_source_avgs fsa ON pr.fundflux = fsa.fundflux) SELECT * FROM final_results ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
